Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) Data Entry Operator (Scope of Work)

Scope of Work Roles, Responsibilities and Duties of Data Entry Operator (Office) (Appointment on Contractual Basis in Kendriya Vidyalaya – Office Administration, Email and Corresponden ce Management) 1. Introduction Efficient office administration and timely handling of data, correspondence and communication are vital fo r the smooth functioning of Kendriya Vidyalaya schools. With increasing dependence on digital platforms, online portals and electronic communication, the role of a Data Entry Operator (DEO) has become cruci al in supporting academic and administrative operations. The Data Entry Operator, appointed on a contractual basis, is responsible for accurate data handling, management of official email communication, maintenance of office records and files, and providing cleric al and IT-related support to the school administration in accordance with Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan (K VS) norms. 2. Objective of the Post The objective of engaging a Data Entry Operator on a contractual basis is to: · Ensure accurate and timely data entry and record maintenance. · Manage official email communication (inward and outward). · Support efficient office correspondence and file management. · Assist school administration in digital and clerical work. · Enhance transparency, efficiency and responsiveness in office functioning. 3. Scope of Work The scope of work of the Data Entry Operator includes, but is not limited to, the following areas: 1. Data entry and record maintenance 2. Management of official email communication 3. Office correspondence and file handling 4. Support in online portals and digital platforms 5. Clerical and administrative assistance 6. Coordination with school staff and authorities 7. Confidentiality, data security and compliance 4. Roles and Responsibilities 4.1 Data Entry and Record Maintenance · Enter, update and maintain accurate data related to students, staff, examinations, fees, attendance and ot her school records. · Maintain digital databases and spread sheets as instructed by school authorities. · Assist in preparation of reports, statements and data summaries. · Ensure correctness, consistency and timely updating of all records. 4.2 Management of Official Email (Inward and Outward) · Monitor the official school email ID(s) on a regular basis.

· Receive record and route inward emails to the concerned sections or officials. · Draft, type and send official outgoing emails as per instructions of the Principal or authorized officer. · Maintain proper email records, folders and backups for future reference. · Ensure timely replies to emails and follow-up on pending communications. 4.3 Office Correspondence and File Management · Assist in drafting, typing and formatting official letters, circulars, notices and office orders. · Maintain physical and electronic files systematically with proper indexing and labelling. · Keep record inward and outward correspondence in relevant registers or digital systems. · Ensure safe custody and easy retrieval of office files and documents. 4.4 Support in Online Portals and Digital Platforms · Assist in data uploading and updating on portals such as KVS, UDISE+, CBSE, Samagra, payroll, fees and ot her government platforms, as directed. · Support online submissions, reports and compliance requirements. · Assist staff in basic computer-related tasks and troubleshooting, when required. 4.5 Clerical and Administrative Assistance · Provide clerical support to the Principal, Office Superintendent and office staff. · Assist in preparation of statements, lists, presentations and documents. · Help in photocopying, scanning, printing and digitization of records. · Perform any other office-related duty assigned by school authorities. 4.6 Coordination and Communication · Coordinate with teaching and non-teaching staff for collection and compilation of data. · Liaise with Regional Office, KVS Headquarters and other institutions through official correspondence. · Ensure smooth flow of information within the school office. 4.7 Confidentiality, Data Security and Compliance · Maintain strict confidentiality of official records, emails and sensitive data. · Ensure data security and follow instructions related to passwords and access control. · Avoid unauthorized sharing of information or documents. · Comply with KVS rules, IT policies and administrative guidelines. 5. Duties and Daily Responsibilities The Data Entry Operator shall: · Report to duty punctually and work during assigned office hours. · Timings: 08.30 a.m. to 04.30 p.m. · Maintain accuracy, speed and neatness in data entry and documentation. · Prioritize official emails and correspondence as per urgency.

· Ensure timely submission of data, reports and replies. · Maintain a professional and cooperative work attitude. 6. Professional Conduct and Ethics · Adhere strictly to Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan rules, school discipline and office procedures. · Maintain courteous behaviour with staff, students and visitors. · Refrain from misuse of office computers, internet or email facilities. · Avoid unnecessary use of mobile phones during working hours. 7. Contractual Terms and Accountability · The appointment shall be purely contractual for the period specified by the Kendriya Vidyalaya. · The Data Entry Operator shall not claim any right for regularisation or permanent appointment. · Services may be terminated as per contractual terms or in case of negligence, data errors, breach of confi dentiality or unsatisfactory performance. · Performance shall be reviewed periodically by the school authorities. 8. Conclusion The Data Entry Operator appointed on a contractual basis is a key administrative support functionary in Ke ndriya Vidyalaya schools. Through efficient data management, timely handling of official emails and syste matic maintenance of office files and correspondence, the DEO contributes significantly to smooth adminis tration, transparency and effective communication, in alignment with the objectives and operational stand ards of Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan. ककाायय कक पपररििधध (उउाानन ससेवेवााओओं ं ककेे ििललएए) / Scope of Work (For Gardening Services) 1. ककाायय ककाा ससममयय: ातः 7:30 बजे से अपरा 4:00 बजे तक। Duty Hours: 7:30 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. 2. वालय परसर के अदं र और चारदवार के आसपास खरपतवार, झाड़याँ, रसोई उान, लॉन आद क सफाई एव ंरखरखाव। Cleaning and maintenance of weeds, bushes, medicinal garden, lawns, and areas around the compo und wall. 3. फूल क यारया ँतैयार करना, पौधारोपण, खाद डालना, पानी देना, गमल क देखरेख, एव ंबागवानी सजावट काय। Maintenance of flower beds, planting, manuring, watering, and beautification of the campus through flower pots and hedges. 4. सूखी पयाँ, शाखाए,ँ घास आद का एकीकरण और उिचत िनपटान। Collection and proper disposal of dry leaves, branches, and grass. 5. पौध क छँटाई, खाद, कटनाशक एव ंफफूंदनाशक का योग आवयकतानुसार करना। Pruning, manuring, and applying fertilizers/insecticides/pesticides as required. 6. लॉन, माग और दवार के कनार पर हेज़ बनाना और िनयिमत छँटाई करना। Making and trimming hedges along roads, lawns, and boundary walls. 7. घास और खरपतवार क िनयिमत कटाई श कटर या लॉनमूवर मशीन से क जाएगी (मशीन वालय ारा उपलध कराई जाएगी) । Regular cutting of grass and weeds using brush cutter or lawn mower (to be provided by the Vidyalaya). 8. तैनात किमय के कारण कसी भी हािन क थित म वालय को एजसी से ितपूित का दावा करन ेका अिधकार होगा। In case of any loss caused by deployed staff, the Vidyalaya reserves the right to recover damages fr om the agency.
